supersession_reason: Pre-execution refinement only: avoid false-negative classification if raw schema exposes an ambiguous setOracle label without enough context to distinguish native validator-oracle from HIP-3/deployer oracle. No source bytes were opened under V0.1.
source_rationale: Raw S3 explorer_blocks objects are a materially different storage representation from the Explorer blockDetails JSON surface already tested. This is source-schema recovery only and does not reopen economic outcomes.

authorization_gate.rule: No S3 request may occur without a separate immutable P0F authorization amendment and exact runtime confirmation.

deterministic_object_hypothesis.basis: Pre-execution observed archive hierarchy groups explorer_blocks into 100,000,000 / 1,000,000 / 100-height buckets with .rmp.lz4 objects.

cost_and_completeness_caps.rule: HEAD all four exact frozen keys before any GET. If any key is missing or caps would be exceeded, fail closed before body download.

schema_extraction_policy.rule: Any oracle-related path or type/action/variant/kind label is a schema candidate. P0F must not declare it native merely from the token setOracle; identity is deferred to a separately frozen audit.

decision_rule.PASS_ORACLE_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ID: All four frozen raw objects exist, fit caps, decode under the frozen decoder, and expose at least one oracle-related key path or action/type/variant/kind label. This does not establish native BTC/ETH oracle identity; it only permits a separately frozen identity/reconstruction audit.
decision_rule.FAIL_NO_ORACLE_SCHEMA_VISIBLE: All four frozen raw objects exist and decode within caps but expose no oracle-related key path or action/type/variant/kind label.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_SOURCE_COVERAGE: At least one frozen exact key is absent.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED_COST_OR_DECODER: Byte caps or the frozen decoder prevent complete source-schema adjudication.
decision_rule.BLOCKED_NO_AUTHORIZATION: Separate P0F requester-pays authorization is absent.
